name: search
description: Search the 21st.dev catalog across ALL entity types - React/shadcn components, themes, and templates - returning lightweight metadata ONLY (name, description, preview image, author, url/install, id, and price for templates). Use `type` to scope to one kind, or 'all' (default) to search everything. FREE. Retrieval differs by kind: for a component result call get_component with its `id` (that id is a demo id) for the PAID code; for a theme call get_theme with its `id` (a uuid) for the free CSS; templates have no code to fetch - open their `url`. NOTE: `author`/`mine`/`liked` bypass ranking and return a plain recency-ordered list (query/sort/tag/color are ignored when any of them is set); component listings via `mine`/`author` only ever show PUBLIC components - your own private/team components are discoverable via list_team_components, not search. Pass `runtime: 'remotion'` (optionally `kind`, `aspect`) to search 21st Video blocks, Remotion components for programmatic video; without it results are UI only. Returns plain data, no picker UI - use this for your own lookups. If the USER should see a visual list of options and pick one, use `search_picker` instead (identical params, same results, but renders an inline picker on hosts that support it).

aspect.description: runtime 'remotion' only: blocks that support this aspect ratio.

author.description: Filter to items by this username.

free.description: Templates only: true = free (price 0), false = paid. No effect elsewhere.

kind.description: runtime 'remotion' only: the video block kind.

liked.description: Filter to items the caller has bookmarked.

mine.description: Filter to the signed-in caller's own items.

query.description: What you need, e.g. 'pricing table', 'dark violet theme', 'saas template'.

runtime.description: 'ui' (default): React/shadcn components, themes, templates. 'remotion': 21st Video blocks (Remotion components) only. A bare 'video' query stays UI unless you pass 'remotion'.

sort.description: Themes: recommended|popular|newest. Templates: recommended|date|price. No effect on components (always relevance-ranked).
